content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect order of operations in the `flb_http_client` function, where the `Content-Length` header was being added before the body was set. This led to the `Content-Length` header potentially being incorrect or missing, as it needed to reflect the actual length of the body data that was set later in the function. The patch corrects this by moving the call to `add_host_and_content_length(c)` to after the body length is determined, ensuring that the `Content-Length` header accurately represents the size of the body.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect order of operations in the `flb_http_client` function, where the `Content-Length` header was being added before the body was set. This led to the `Content-Length` header potentially being incorrect or missing, as it needed to reflect the actual length of the body data that was set later in the function. The patch corrects this by moving the call to `add_host_and_content_length(c)` to after the body length is determined, ensuring that the `Content-Length` header accurately represents the size of the body.
Patch:
From 4ddb3050c04ec24ae84bbeceb6c8723c493bf9e9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wesley Pettit <wppttt@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jan 2020 23:06:06 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] http_client: add content-length header after body is set
 (#1895)

fixes a bug I committed in fcf15a9

Signed-off-by: Wesley Pettit <wppttt@amazon.com>
---
 src/flb_http_client.c | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/flb_http_client.c b/src/flb_http_client.c
index 4799d740e..26c12bc26 100644
--- a/src/flb_http_client.c
+++ b/src/flb_http_client.c
@@ -567,8 +567,6 @@ struct flb_http_client *flb_http_client(struct flb_upstream_conn *u_conn,
     c->flags       = flags;
     mk_list_init(&c->headers);
 
-    add_host_and_content_length(c);
-
     /* Check if we have a query string */
     p = strchr(uri, '?');
     if (p) {
@@ -593,6 +591,8 @@ struct flb_http_client *flb_http_client(struct flb_upstream_conn *u_conn,
         c->body_len = body_len;
     }
 
+    add_host_and_content_length(c);
+
     /* Check proxy data */
     if (proxy) {
         ret = proxy_parse(proxy, c);
--
